description: District Secretariat Matara - Notifying that the Annual Esala Festival - 2016 of Sri Vishnu Maha Devala of Devinuwara Matara District will be held from 13.07.2016 to 27.07.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the dates for the Annual Esala Festival at a specific religious site (Sri Vishnu Maha Devala of Devinuwara) under the Pilgrimage Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any specialized categories (4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. This falls under cultural/religious administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
